    Spanning string morphisms by coefficient-component maps #

    The finite coefficient constraint graph partitions all possible matrix coefficients into equality components. This file chooses one representative per component and decomposes every actual string-module morphism as the sum of its component coefficient times the corresponding component-indicator map. Components meeting a zero boundary contribute zero automatically.
